articles.title: Caitlin Clark felt 'sick' hearing Fever fans boo head coach Stephanie White following her pregame rant - foxnews.com
articles.description: Caitlin Clark said it made her "a little sick" when Indiana Fever fans booed head coach Stephanie White during pregame introductions Tuesday night.
